# 靈寶淨明天樞院都司法院須知法文

**ID:** KR5b0257
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0257

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-juǎn ritual handbook concluding the four-text *Tiānshūyuàn* cluster of *Jìngmíng* 淨明 manuals (DZ 549 / [KR5b0253](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0253) – DZ 553). Where the preceding *Lìng* ([KR5b0255](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0255)) and *Gé* ([KR5b0256](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0256)) fix the Bureau's administrative statutes and penal regulations, this manual gives the practical *fǎwén* 法文 — the methodical text of the rite — by which an officer of the *Dūsī* internally cultivates his office.

**Abstract**

The opening section, *Tiānshū dūlù xíngchí fǎ* 天樞都録行持法 ("Procedure for the Maintenance of the Office, by the Director-Registrar of the Heavenly-Pivot"), declares the bureaucratic ethos of the Bureau: as *Tiānménsī yuàn* 天門司院, "Court-Office of the Heaven-Gate", it speaks for Heaven (*shàngtiān hóushé* 上天喉舌), superintends the seventy-three sub-offices plus the seven *lùshì* (so "seventy-four offices" *qīshísì sī* 七十四司), and audits the *yīnyáng* good-and-evil records of the Three Worlds. The text then turns to the internal-cultivation methods proper: the *yǎngshén fǎ* 養神法 (sunrise visualisation of the sun's red qì entering the crown and pairing with the moon's white qì in the breast to form an inner cinnabar pellet), the *bìqì* 閉炁 visualisations involving the Western Queen Mother and the *Yínhàn* 銀漢 (Silver River = Milky Way), and so on.

The text shares with [KR5b0254](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0254) (DZ 550) the *Shàngqīng* inner-anatomy vocabulary — *níwán* 泥丸, *jiànggōng* 絳宮 — and provides what Schipper & Verellen (*Taoist Canon* 2: 1092–1093, John Lagerwey) describe as the technical *liànjīng* 鍊精 underpinning of the Bureau's executive office. The whole forms one of the most explicit accounts of how a Sòng-Yuán *fǎshī* 法師 was expected to internalise the celestial bureaucratic role in his own body.
